classification.difficultyReason: Read intercepts, horizontal asymptotes and growth or decay directly from supplied graphs, then express their left and right end behaviour. Each feature is explicitly prompted and uses taught graph interpretation.

spec.description: Square unit grid from −5 to 5 on both axes, labelled nonzero integer ticks, double-ended axes and supplied blue growth curve.
spec.mathematics: y=2^x; passes through (0,1), (1,2) and (2,4); horizontal asymptote y=0.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied curve remains visible; feature responses are answer-controlled.

answer.worked: The curve crosses the $y$-axis at $(0,1)$.
The curve approaches the $x$-axis, so the horizontal asymptote is $y=0$.
The curve rises as $x$ increases: increasing, exponential growth.
Following the curve to the right, $y$ increases without bound: $y\to\infty$.
Following the curve to the left, it approaches $y=0$ from above: $y\to0$.
